brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: Three side-by-side cells at q=0,1,2 (r=0, level 0): piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;half-s. Capped open faces and locked joints; check_build is ok with meshClash clear.
drawer:0#0,0#cut (south half of cell 0,0) and drawer:0#2,0#cut (north half of cell 2,0), each filling the empty half of a half-base cell.

setDrawerOpen applied to the drawer in cell (0,0,0); the drawer in cell (2,0,0) is left closed. I did not verify the pulled-open pose visually: the look tool did not render the drawer as seen, so this rests on the setDrawerOpen op succeeding.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
